name_reason: Current name is misleading. 'chapter_intro' implies a chapter-START cinematic, but this runs at chapter-21 END from the sole caller fd2_chapter_21_end (call site 0x242C9), only after the 6-item (0xD1..0xD6) collection unlock that grants item 100 (sky key / 天空之鑰). 'chapter_intro' also collides conceptually with the genuine chapter-intro functions in chintro.c (fd2_chapter_intro_menu_*), which are unrelated party/pose-selection screens. Proposed name follows the established fd2_play_* cinematic precedent (cf. fd2_play_game_ending_cinematic, fd2_play_final_chapter_30_ending), encodes the chapter-21 domain ID (a meaningful chapter ID, kept) and the actual purpose (hidden-stage unlock cinematic). No address remnant in current or proposed name.
purpose: Play the chapter-21 hidden-stage unlock cinematic: a 101-frame (0x65) sprite slideshow off FDOTHER.DAT[0x22] with a mid-show white flash, run at chapter-21 end after the player collects all 6 unlock items and is granted the sky key (item 100).
logic_summary: Pans cursor/window to (0xE,8); mallocs a 64000-byte workspace and snapshots the live VGA framebuffer (0xA0000) into it; loads FDOTHER.DAT[0x22] sprite sheet and blits base frame 0 into the workspace. Phase 1 (frames 1..0x44, with palette cycling): per frame copy workspace -> large_game_state_buffer scratch, blit the frame, copy scratch -> 0xA0000, advance palette cycle, hold 3 BIOS ticks, drain keyboard. Then plays ANI sequence 0, flashes white (set palette range add +0x3F, hold 100ms), restores (add +0, hold 500ms). Phase 2 (frames 0x45..0x64, no palette cycling): same blit/copy, hold 3 ticks, drain keyboard. Frees workspace and sprite sheet, then composites battle frame 0 (original compiles this trailing call as a tail JMP replacing the epilogue; the plain call here is the functional equivalent).
reads_globals: data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr (scratch far buffer used as the per-frame blit target, read/written like 0xA0000)
comment_original_issue: The source comment prose was already accurate and complete (correctly described the chapter-21 hidden-stage context, 101-frame count, both phases, white flash, scratch-buffer note, and tail-call note). It only lacked an explicit one-line framing that this is the hidden-stage UNLOCK cinematic running at chapter-21 END (not a chapter intro) and the item-100 sky-key payoff. Augmented the header lines accordingly; rest unchanged.
